units.source_text: 我指了那个搔腿的女人。

en.t: I pointed to the woman who was scratching her leg.

units.source_text: 那时她的脚生起的微痒，大概就是在这些花砖面上彷徨的库蚊刺伤的痕迹，成了把我和她联结在一起的缘分……

en.t: The faint itch that had risen in her foot then was probably the trace of a mosquito bite from one of the mosquitoes wandering over these patterned tiles, and it became the bond that joined her and me together...

units.source_text: 多亏这份痒，她日后才会获得成为我的证人的权利。

en.t: Thanks to that itch, she would later gain the right to become my witness.
